title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: Twilio customers are experiencing SMS delivery failures to Telemat Cel subscribers in Brazil.
backbase_rationale: The outage could affect Backbase SMS sending; immediate mitigation steps are required.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Removal of the Send to Coworker action from SendGrid Domain Authentication reduces available setup options, requiring users to use other communication methods for DNS record updates.
backbase_rationale: Backbase systems that integrate with SendGrid domain authentication should evaluate if they rely on the Send to Coworker action and adjust accordingly.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: Minimum Android SDK version increased to 24, requiring updates for apps targeting lower Android versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update integration to support Android 24+ and ensure backward compatibility.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: SDK added support for Digital Identity using eIDAS in selected countries, aligning with regulatory requirements.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should confirm eIDAS support meets local regulatory compliance; code changes may be needed if using eIDAS features.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe France
impact_summary: Twilio customers are experiencing SMS delivery delays to Free Caraibe subscribers in France.
backbase_rationale: The delay is identified and ongoing, no immediate impact on Backbase services; monitoring is sufficient.
